causeTitle.format:
RENT AGREEMENT / LEASE DEED

This Rent Agreement is executed on this {date} at {place}.

BETWEEN

{applicant}, {applicantAddress}
(hereinafter referred to as the "LANDLORD" / "LESSOR")

AND

{respondent}, {respondentAddress}
(hereinafter referred to as the "TENANT" / "LESSEE")

mandatoryClauses.name: Property Description
mandatoryClauses.description: Complete description of the rented property including address, area, floor

mandatoryClauses.name: Rent Amount and Payment
mandatoryClauses.description: Monthly rent, due date, mode of payment, escalation clause

mandatoryClauses.name: Security Deposit
mandatoryClauses.description: Security deposit amount, conditions for refund

mandatoryClauses.name: Tenure / Duration
mandatoryClauses.description: Lease period (start date, end date), renewal terms

mandatoryClauses.name: Maintenance Responsibilities
mandatoryClauses.description: Who bears maintenance costs — landlord vs tenant

mandatoryClauses.name: Termination Clause
mandatoryClauses.description: Notice period and conditions for early termination by either party

filingChecklist: Agreement printed on stamp paper of appropriate value (state-specific)
Signed by both Landlord and Tenant
Signed by two witnesses with full details
Registered at Sub-Registrar office (mandatory if term > 11 months)
Aadhaar / ID proof of both parties

sections.description: Duration of certain leases in absence of written contract
Rights and liabilities of lessor and lessee
Documents of which registration is compulsory

promptInstructions: Draft a Rent Agreement / Lease Deed under the Transfer of Property Act, 1882.
Include a detailed property description clause with full address, floor, area (sq ft), and built-up/carpet area if provided.
State monthly rent amount in figures and words, due date (e.g., 1st of every month), and mode of payment.
Include rent escalation clause (typically 5-10% annual increase).
State security deposit amount, conditions for deduction, and refund timeline (typically within 30 days of vacating).
Specify lease tenure with exact start and end dates, and renewal terms.
Include maintenance and utility clauses — who pays electricity, water, society maintenance.
Include termination clause with notice period (typically 1-2 months) for both parties.
Include restrictions: no subletting, no structural changes without consent, permitted use (residential/commercial).
Include dispute resolution clause (mediation/arbitration before litigation).
If tenure exceeds 11 months, note that registration is mandatory under S.17 Registration Act.
Include witness signature blocks at the end.
Use clear, plain legal language. Avoid overly archaic terms.
Do NOT generate signature blocks — they are added programmatically.

CRITICAL — PARTY ROLES: The applicant ({applicant}) is the LANDLORD / LESSOR (Party of the First Part). The respondent ({respondent}) is the TENANT / LESSEE (Party of the Second Part). Never swap these roles at any point in the document.

CRITICAL — NO DUPLICATE PREAMBLE: Do NOT write a document title, heading (e.g. 'RESIDENTIAL RENT AGREEMENT'), preamble, or party-identification section. The preamble is generated separately and will be prepended. Start the AI-generated content DIRECTLY with 'CLAUSE 1' and continue sequentially through all clauses.
